base_member_text: With nfile=[1], the else branch (L79-L82) never runs, so no colorbar is drawn in the default configuration; 'min' and 'length' shadow Python builtins
audit_member_text: The colorbar is created only in the else branch at lines 79-82. With the default one-element nfile at line 29, num is always zero and the saved plot has no Hsig colorbar; with multiple files, only non-first subplots receive one.

base_member_text: plt.hold(True) @L58 was removed from matplotlib (deprecated 2.0, removed 3.0) — script requires an old matplotlib
audit_member_text: plt.hold(True) at line 58 assumes a pyplot hold API and can raise AttributeError in Matplotlib versions where hold was removed; no compatibility branch is present.

base_member_text: Quiver slicing @L63 uses len(u) (row count) for both dimensions (0:len(u)-1:sk twice) — for non-square grids the column slice bound is wrong (m != n); the masked arrays u_masked/v_masked are computed (L48-L49) but the unmasked u,v are what quiver plots
audit_member_text: The quiver call at line 63 uses len(u) for both row and column slice limits. For the rectangular n-by-m beach grid established at line 15, the column extent should follow m/shape[1]; the copied row bound produces a U/V shape that does not match the x coordinate vector when n differs from m.

base_member_text: os is used (L12, L42-L45) but never imported — the script raises NameError as shipped; import os is missing
fdir @L9 is a workshop-specific absolute path; must be edited per user (comments L7-L8)

audit_member_text: The script uses os.path.join beginning at line 12 but imports only numpy and matplotlib at lines 4-5. os is undefined, so execution fails on the first data load before any plotting.

Masking creates u_masked and v_masked at lines 48-49, but the quiver call at line 63 uses raw u and v. Dry-cell vectors therefore remain visible even though the comment at line 47 says values where mask=0 should not be plotted.

Shapes of eta, mask, u, v, and ht are not checked before masked_where and plotting at lines 48-63, min[num] at line 56 assumes min and nfile have equal lengths, and the fixed absolute fdir at line 9 is machine-specific.
